title: ἡ ἡμέρα τῆς Κοάλας
learning_goal: Practice present-tense third-person movement and search verbs with location prepositions: ἐξέρχεται/εἰσέρχεται/βαίνει with ἐκ/εἰς/πρὸς, and ζητεῖ/εὑρίσκει/κρύπτει/κλέπτει with ἐν and ὑπό.
plot: Koala wakes, packs an apple, bread, and a ball, goes to school where Korax steals and hides the bag; Koala searches under a table and a chair, finds the bag in a box, eats and plays, then goes home and sleeps.

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα ἐκβαίνει ἐκ τῆς κλίνης.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
a shiny red apple with a small green leaf
a small round loaf of bread with a golden crust
a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Koala lies under the green blanket on the small bed at right, then she sits up and swings her feet to the floor.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child rests closed on the floor at the foot of the bed on the left.
The red apple, round loaf of bread, and blue-and-white leather ball are arranged in a pile near the backpack

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα εἰσφέρει εἰς τὸν σάκκον τὸ μῆλον καὶ τὸν ἄρτον καὶ τὴν σφαῖραν.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
a shiny red apple with a small green leaf
a small round loaf of bread with a golden crust
a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Koala sits on the edge of the bed at left, reaching down with both hands toward the open backpack.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child sits open on the floor in front of Koala.
The shiny red apple with a small green leaf rests beside the backpack flap ready to go in.
The small round loaf of bread with a golden crust sits near the apple at Koala’s toes.
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit rests to the right of the backpack.

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα ἐξέρχεται ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας μετὰ τοῦ σάκκου.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
positioning: Koala steps through the open cottage doorway at center-right onto the cobblestone path, smiling toward the garden.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child is worn on Koala’s back with the flap closed.

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα βαίνει πρὸς τὴν σχολὴν.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
positioning: Koala walks along the curved cobblestone path towards the school. We only see the back of his head because he is looking at the school.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child rides on Koala’s back bouncing lightly as she walks.

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα εἰσέρχεται εἰς τὴν σχολὴν.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
positioning: Koala steps over the stone threshold at the school door at center, facing inward.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child is on Koala’s back as she enters.

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα τίθησι τὸν σάκκον ἐπὶ τὴν τράπεζαν καὶ καθίζει ἐπὶ τὴν καθέδραν.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
a low honey-brown wooden table with four sturdy legs
a simple wooden chair with a woven rush seat and a short back
positioning: Koala sits in the chair.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child sits on the tabletop at center.
The low honey-brown wooden table with four sturdy legs stands at center.
The simple wooden chair with a woven rush seat and a short back is positioned at the table where Koala sits.

frames.text: οἴμοι! ὁ Κόραξ προσέρχεται καὶ κλέπτει τὸν σάκκον ἀπὸ τῆς τραπέζης. ἡ Κοάλα λυπεῖται.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
a low honey-brown wooden table with four sturdy legs
a simple wooden chair with a woven rush seat and a short back
positioning: Koala sits in the chair facing away from the table, not seeing Korax approach.
Korax swoops in from the right with wings spread, grabbing the bag from the table.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child is being lifted from the table by Korax.
The low honey-brown wooden table with four sturdy legs stands at center.
The simple wooden chair with a woven rush seat and a short back holds Koala at the table.

frames.text: ὁ Κόραξ κρύπτει τὸν σάκκον ἐν τῇ κιβωτῷ. ὁ κόραξ κακός ἐστιν.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
a cedar storage box with a hinged lid and a small bronze latch
a low honey-brown wooden table with four sturdy legs
a simple wooden chair with a woven rush seat and a short back
positioning: Korax crouches at right, glancing over his shoulder as he pushes the bag into the box.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child is halfway inside the open box.
The cedar storage box with a hinged lid and a small bronze latch sits against the wall at right with the lid raised.
The low honey-brown wooden table with four sturdy legs stands a little left of center in the background.
The simple wooden chair with a woven rush seat and a short back is angled near the table with its front legs visible.

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα ζητεῖ τὸν σάκκον ὑπὸ τὴν τράπεζαν. ὁ σάκκος οὐκ ἔστιν.
objects: a low honey-brown wooden table with four sturdy legs
positioning: Koala kneels at right and leans to look beneath the tabletop. He is sad.
The low honey-brown wooden table with four sturdy legs sits at left with clear space under it.
frames.artist_notes: Koala is sad because the bag is missing. Do not draw a bag.

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα ζητεῖ ὑπὸ τὴν καθέδραν. ὁ σάκκος οὐκ ἔστιν.
objects: a simple wooden chair with a woven rush seat and a short back
positioning: Koala crouches low at left, peering beneath the chair. He is sad and crying.
The simple wooden chair with a woven rush seat and a short back stands at center with a small shadow under it.

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα ζητεῖ ἐν τῇ κιβωτῷ. ἡ Κοάλα εὑρίσκει τὸν σάκκον καὶ χαίρει.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
a cedar storage box with a hinged lid and a small bronze latch
positioning: Koala kneels at center-right, lifting the lid with one paw and smiling wide.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child sits inside the open box.
The cedar storage box with a hinged lid and a small bronze latch is open at center-right with the lid tilted back.

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα πάλιν βαίνει πρὸς τὴν τράπεζαν καὶ καθίζει ἐπὶ τὴν καθέδραν μετὰ τοῦ σάκκου.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
a low honey-brown wooden table with four sturdy legs
a simple wooden chair with a woven rush seat and a short back
positioning: Koala walks from right toward the table carrying the closed backpack, then sits in the chair.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child is held in Koala's arms.
The low honey-brown wooden table with four sturdy legs stands at center.
The simple wooden chair with a woven rush seat and a short back is positioned at the table where Koala sits.

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα ἐκφέρει ἐκ τοῦ σάκκου τὸ μῆλον καὶ τὸν ἄρτον. ἡ Κοάλα ἐσθίει τὸ μῆλον καὶ τὸν ἄρτον.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
a shiny red apple with a small green leaf
a small round loaf of bread with a golden crust
a low honey-brown wooden table with four sturdy legs
a simple wooden chair with a woven rush seat and a short back
positioning: Koala sits at the table with a happy face, holding the apple in one paw.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child lies open on the tabletop.
The shiny red apple with a small green leaf is in Koala's left paw near her mouth.
The small round loaf of bread with a golden crust sits on the table within reach.
The low honey-brown wooden table with four sturdy legs fills the center of the scene.
The simple wooden chair with a woven rush seat and a short back supports Koala at the table.

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα ἐκφέρει ἐκ τοῦ σάκκου τὴν σφαῖραν καὶ παίζει τῇ σφαίρᾳ.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a low honey-brown wooden table with four sturdy legs
a simple wooden chair with a woven rush seat and a short back
positioning: Koala stands beside the chair bouncing the ball with both paws, smiling.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child remains open on the tabletop.
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit is in the air between Koala's paws.
The low honey-brown wooden table with four sturdy legs stands at center.
The simple wooden chair with a woven rush seat and a short back is pushed slightly back from the table.

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα ἐξέρχεται ἐκ τῆς σχολῆς μετὰ τοῦ σάκκου.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
positioning: Koala steps down from the school threshold toward the path facing right.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child is closed and worn on Koala’s back.

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα βαίνει πρὸς τὴν οἰκίαν.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
positioning: Koala walks along the cobblestone path from right toward left with the cottage appearing ahead.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child rests on Koala’s back as she walks.

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα εἰσέρχεται εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
positioning: Koala moves through the open doorway from the porch into the warm interior.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child is on Koala’s back as she crosses the threshold.

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα τίθησι τὸν σάκκον παρὰ τὴν κλίνην καὶ ἀναβαίνει εἰς τὴν κλίνην.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
positioning: Koala stands beside the bed at right, placing the backpack gently on the floor, then climbs onto the bed.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child is being set down beside the bed leg by Koala.

frames.text: ἡ Κοάλα πάλιν καθεύδει ἐν τῇ κλίνῃ.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
positioning: Koala curls under the forest-green blanket on the bed at right with eyes closed.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child sits neatly on the floor beside the bed leg.
